correctness.rationale: For each input pair the positive-part secant slopes yield a linear frozen branch A_theta fixing constants. Absolutely summable jump decomposition reduces the full BV seminorm to step columns. The exact ramp formula is a separately convex finite optimization; binary branch masks produce weighted nonadjacent descents, maximized by floor(r^2/4). A positive-definite principal minor of I-Q_r realizes every optimal mask using finite supported data and a nonnegative baseline, proving attainment at every radius. Reconstructed boundary cases r=1 and r=2 and all quantified real bi-infinite BV inputs. Exact rational exhaustive small-radius and witness checks provide independent computation corroboration, not infinite certification.

value.rationale: Two-choice centered box averaging is a natural restricted maximal reconstruction operator, and BV is the natural control for jump artifacts. The exact two-input sharp law identifies a qualitative transition from nonexpansive radius one to expansive radius two and shows linear-in-radius instability despite each branch being an averaging/identity operation. The all-radius characterization and attained step perturbations provide meaningful nonlinear stability structure and delimit expectations from one-input variation estimates.
